snippet.title: Pikifen - Quick Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
**Quick update**: 1.2 will launch more along the lines of mid August. Stay tuned!

Learn more and download it here! https://github.com/Espyo/Pikifen

Pikifen is an engine in which you can create your own Pikmin fan content, play with it, and share it around! From custom areas, to new Pikmin types, to altered hazards, you can use the powerful built-in editors and the comprehensive included manual to bring your ideas to life! Or just play around with the handful of loose content that comes included!

This trailer was made for Kaze Emanuar's 2026 F3 presentation: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=75dCCJWgfzk
